thread:
marco: telemetry alert — env-sync-detector flagged a config drift between prod and staging for cluster 'us-west-2-a'. Summary: prod nodepool 'gpu-pool' has taints (gpu=true:NoSchedule) and autoscale max=16; staging gpu-pool missing taints and autoscale max=8. networkPolicy 'default-deny' = true in prod, false in staging. https://telemetry.internal/drift/1779998888

infra-bot: automated diff attached. terraform diff, helm values diff, and suggested severity=medium. Suggested action: open GitOps PR to reconcile or add guardrails. (diff link: https://telemetry.internal/diff/1779998888) :warning:

alex: heads-up — prod taints are intentional to isolate GPU workloads. If we copy prod -> staging we risk breaking staging CI that expects schedule on non-tainted nodes. prefer adding tolerations to CI runners first.

priya: cost note — increasing staging autoscale max from 8 -> 16 would be ~+$2k/mo. we should avoid that unless necessary. tolerations sound cheaper.

jamie: I can add tolerations to the runner chart. also FYI the diff surfaced an unrelated helm variance: redwood-app.sidecar.prometheus.enabled=true in prod vs false in staging. not critical for this fix but noted.

sre-oncall: risk assessment: networkPolicy mismatch could cause different e2e behavior. recommend policy check in CI and a canary reconcile flow: apply to staging via GitOps, run smoke tests, then promote.

devx: proposed plan:
1) make a GitOps branch in infra/cluster-configs with three small changes: add taints to staging nodepool, add tolerations to runner chart, set networkPolicy.enabled=true in staging values (but keep autoscale.max unchanged)
2) add a CI policy job (conftest/OPA) to validate: no staging autoscale.max > 12, nodepool taints present for gpu pools, networkPolicy present
3) have reconcile-bot open PR with computed diffs and add label reconcile/smoke to trigger smoke test pipeline

ops-automation: I can wire the reconcile-bot + CI job. example terraform plan snippet from the detection run:
```
  # aws_eks_node_group.gpu_pool will be updated in-place
  ~ taints                          = [] -> [
      {
        effect = "NO_SCHEDULE"
        key    = "gpu"
        value  = "true"
      },
    ]
```

marco: agreed we should NOT increase staging autoscale max. priya: do you buy tolerations + taints + networkPolicy=true with autoscale cap unchanged?

priya: yes, signoff on tolerations + taints + networkPolicy as long as autoscale.max stays at 8 and we add a policy guard to block accidental increases. also request a one-hour smoke test window after merge.

alex: I'll PR runner tolerations change and add a unit test to chart ci. tagging @jamie for review.

jamie: will review and add integration test to ensure runners schedule on tainted nodes (with tolerations).

infra-bot: created INF-4872 for the drift and scheduled reconcile-bot to run at 02:00 UTC to open the initial PR. PR preview: https://git.company/infra/cluster-configs/pull/456

marco: can we also post the telemetry alert to #eng-oncall? want visibility during the reconcile window.

devx: done — alert subscription added to #eng-oncall and policy checks are added to the pre-merge pipeline. :thumbsup:

ops-automation: reconcile-bot will open the PR with three commits: 1) taints on staging nodegroup, 2) tolerations in runner chart, 3) helm values networkPolicy.enabled=true for staging. autoscale.max preserved. It will also add a pre-merge conftest check.

marco: perfect. thanks team. keeping this thread open for updates during the reconcile run.
